Credits.metaDescription: Third-party 3D models, fonts and libraries used by AIRSPACE Wear, with their author and license.
Credits.title: Made with the work of many
Credits.lead: AIRSPACE Wear is a portfolio project. Here are the third-party 3D models, fonts and libraries it uses, with their author, their license and the changes we made.

change.kept_one_shoe: kept one shoe of the original pair
change.reoriented_rescaled: reoriented and rescaled to real size

Credits.modelsNote: The sneaker and ball models come from Sketchfab and were optimized for the web with this project's pipeline. Each one is published in two versions: a full one and a lighter one for low-end devices.
Credits.shareAlike: the modified version is shared under the same license ({license})
Credits.avatarNote: The Hangar 360° avatar (Y Bot) and its animations come from Adobe's Mixamo. Its terms allow using them in projects but not redistributing the original files, so they are not in the public repository and the site loads them from its own storage.

Legal.metaDescription: AIRSPACE Wear is a portfolio project, not affiliated with any brand.
Legal.title: Good to know
Legal.lead: AIRSPACE Wear is a portfolio project: a demo store, not a real one.

affiliation.title: No affiliation
affiliation.body: This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Nike, Adidas, New Balance or any other brand shown. Product names, logos and designs belong to their owners and appear only to illustrate the project.

prices.title: Illustrative prices and stock
prices.body: Prices, sizes, stock and technical data are examples. Nothing is for sale: the cart lives only in your browser and there is no checkout.

models.title: 3D models and licenses
models.body: The 3D models are third-party works published on Sketchfab under Creative Commons licenses. Each one is credited with its author, its license and the changes made to it. One of them (Adidas Samba) is for non-commercial use only.

ai.title: AI stylist
ai.body: The stylist uses an artificial intelligence model that only recommends products from this catalog. Its answers can be wrong. Conversations are not stored.

data.title: Your data
data.body: The site does not ask for accounts or personal data. Your theme, language and cart are stored only in your browser, and you can clear them at any time.

Legal.creditsLink: The authors and licenses of every resource are listed in <link>Credits</link>.
